checkpointPayload.description: Khao sat cac CDN request quan sat duoc, tai asset metadata phu hop de map ID sang ten co the doc, dua ket qua vao popup va tai lieu ma khong them polling/API call tu extension.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Kiem ke URL CDN trong HAR/log va kiem tra asset cong khai da quan sat. 2. Chon nguon mapping co the kiem chung va luu du lieu can thiet trong extension. 3. Them cot ten popup voi fallback, cap nhat docs. 4. Kiem tra test/build/validate.
